title.headline:
300 side letters.
Answers the same day.

end.line: Quillon for Oakhurst Trust’s fund legal team

vo: Oakhurst Trust’s fund lawyers handle three hundred side letters per fundraise, with every most-favoured-nation election tracked in spreadsheets.
Quillon reviews every side letter at once and puts each term in its own column, across the whole fundraise.
Ask one question across the whole fund, and Quillon reads every side letter in the vault before it answers.
When investor relations emails, Quillon drafts the reply in Outlook the same day, cited to the clause.
Sofia will walk your team through it on Wednesday the eleventh.
